6666.title: Approval requests hide the follow-up editor and omit response text
6666.rootCauseOneLine: Pending interactions hide the retained editor and block submission; approval responses have no user text field, and Claude denials use a fixed message.
6666.proposedFix: Define atomic redirect/decision semantics and extend the typed approval response path before changing composer visibility; no simple safe fix under the permission/schema exclusions.
6666.caveats: Repeated component-level failure in two clean trusted checkouts; live macOS/Claude timing and screenshots unverified because Chrome/Chromium is unavailable. No production fix or PR.
